sentences.text: Prashant vs State Of Uttarakhand on 13 August, 2024

Author: Ravindra Maithani
Bench: Ravindra Maithani
 High Court Of Uttarakhand At Nainital
 First Bail Application No. 1541 of 2024
 Prashant ........Applicant
 Versus
 State of Uttarakhand ........Respondent
 Present:-
 Mr. Vaibhav Singh Chauhan, Advocate for the applicant.

entities.text: High Court Of Uttarakhand At Nainital
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Mr. V.S. Rawat, A.G.A. for the State.

Applicant is in judicial custody in Case Crime No.817 of 2023, under Sections 363, 366, 376(2)(n),
376(3) and 506 Ipc and Section 3(a)/4(II) and 5(l)/6 of the Protection of Children from Sexual
Offences Act, 2012, Police Station- Laksar, District- Haridwar.
He has sought his release on bail.

2. Heard learned counsel for the parties and perused the record.
3. According to the FIR, the applicant enticed the victim, a young girl, in the intervening night of .10.2023, at 1:00 PM, and took her away.
4.

Learned counsel for the applicant would submit that the victim has already been examined under Section 164 of the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973 ("the Code"); the victim has yet not been examined in the Court; in her statement under Section 164 of the Code, the victim has not supported the prosecution case and has stated that nothing happened between her and the applicant and she,
on her own, had left her house.
5. These facts are admitted by learned State Counsel.
6. Having considered, this Court is of the view that it is a case fit for bail and the applicant deserves to be enlarged on bail.
8. Let the applicant be released on bail, on his executing a personal bond and furnishing two reliable sureties, each of the like amount, to the satisfaction of the court concerned.

(Ravindra Maithani, J) 13.08.2024 Ravi Bisht Prashant vs State Of Uttarakhand on 13 August, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/3304431/
